title: Bind capability evidence to environment and expiry
rawUserRequest: Complete WI-16 capability-expiration-environment-binding: capability evidence must be time-bounded and environment-bound; changed inputs automatically make evidence stale, stale evidence cannot support claims, and re-verification restores it.

declaredIntent.summary: Add deterministic, local capability-evidence freshness evaluation without claiming external provider verification.

outOfScope: Changing provider configuration, branch protection, or external provider claims.

sources.reason: Repository-local traceability record for the user-provided WI-16 requirements.

riskAssessment.reason: A freshness mistake could incorrectly let obsolete local evidence support a public capability claim.

reasons: Capability claims and fail-closed evidence policy change.

override.approvalEvidence: User authorized governed writes and completion of all Work Items in this thread.
override.reason: Strict evidence policy change requires the strict verification graph.
notRunChecks: external provider configuration verification is out of scope

executionDecision.reason: User authorized Contract and governed writes; all required behavior is repository-local and deterministic.

preReviewWarnings: Provider and branch-protection facts remain external_dependency/not_claimed and must not be synthesized by the freshness evaluator.

checkpointPolicy.reason: Bind implementation and finishing evidence to this Contract.

acceptance: Capability evidence records carry verifiedAt, validUntil, environment, scope, and evidenceFreshness fields with deterministic validation.
A changed bound file, tool major version, schema version, environment snapshot, or expired validUntil makes evidence stale with an explicit reason.
Capability claims reject stale evidence; a fresh re-verification record restores claim eligibility without treating it as provider evidence.
Focused regression tests cover each invalidation condition and refresh recovery; current documentation distinguishes local freshness from external control verification.
Capability Truth projections and their dependent generated documentation are refreshed and remain byte-bound.
guidelines: Fail closed when freshness inputs are absent or malformed.
Keep environment collection deterministic and redact provider credentials or machine-specific secrets.
Do not claim that local evidence proves provider configuration.

intent.problem: Current Capability Truth evidence detects changed source bytes but lacks an explicit expiry and environment binding, so a record can appear current after time or runtime context changes.
constraints: Use a deterministic local snapshot; do not read or alter provider configuration.
intent.rationale: Explicit freshness makes evidence invalidation explainable, testable, and unable to silently support an outdated claim.

scenarioCoverage.scenario: An unexpired record with matching environment and bound evidence is fresh and claim-eligible.
scenarioCoverage.expected: The evaluator returns fresh and the claim gate accepts the record.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Run focused fresh-record and claim-gate regressions.

scenarioCoverage.scenario: Expired or mismatched environment/tool/schema/bound-file records become stale and claims are rejected.
scenarioCoverage.expected: The evaluator reports an explicit stale reason and the claim gate rejects the evidence.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Run focused invalidation and claim-rejection regressions.

scenarioCoverage.scenario: A newly generated matching record restores freshness while retaining the external-provider non-claim.
scenarioCoverage.expected: A replacement record is fresh while its limitation still excludes provider verification.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Run focused refresh regression and inspect documentation non-claim.
